A little note for you

Have you smiled today?

You told me you weren't annoyed by me, and that you're just not good at talking. I completely understand that. But deep down, I can't help but worry that you actually are... or maybe I'm just overthinking it.

I’m really sorry if reaching out to you caused any trouble or made you feel uncomfortable.

I know my actions might seem a bit weird. I'm sorry for acting so cringe... I just really like you, that's all.

But please know that every compliment I gave you came straight from my heart. I've never felt this way about anyone in my entire life... until I met you.

If God is real, I would pray that you never have to feel lonely or sad. I wish I could take all those heavy feelings and carry them myself. I just can't stand the thought of seeing you sad.

When you replied to me for the first time, you made me so incredibly happy.

Honestly, I’ve been dying to know your name. I just never had the courage to ask because I didn't want to make you uncomfortable—since I'm still just a stranger. But if you'd rather not say, I won't force it at all.

I want you to know that I won't give up on liking you. I don't think I could ever feel this way about anyone else. But please rest assured, I have absolutely no intention of making you feel pressured or threatened in any way.

I hope you keep that beautiful smile of yours. Whenever you feel tired, down, or just need to vent... I’m always here to listen.

I might not be the best at talking either, but if it’s about you, I'd gladly listen to everything.

I don't know why, but tears almost came to my eyes while writing this note. I must be going crazy haha.

Honestly, just being able to say goodnight to you every night is already enough for me.

I'll always be right here for you. :)
